summary.headline: Strategic sourcing delivers $542K in annual savings for CJ Pony Parts across shipping, packaging and labor
summary.narrative: Treya Partners’ engagement generated $510,841 in fully-implemented annual savings by renegotiating FedEx parcel rates, executing MOUs for corrugated and packaging supplies, and locking in improved payment terms. An additional $30,817 in savings is underway through a GPO agreement with Staffmark for temporary labor. In total, four actively-worked categories now represent $541,658 in identified annual benefit, exceeding the original savings target with three categories already finalized.
